produced.label: Lethal Leviathan
produced.prompt: Create ONE full-bleed wide landscape 16:9 static background stage for MGS Codec Simulator CQC 2D fighting. Detailed cinematic hand-painted game environment with restrained realistic materials. Match the supplied original game screenshots, their architecture, geometry, colors, era and atmosphere. A human-waist-height side-on camera, with continuous level combat ground running across the bottom 20 percent. ONE coherent scene, no collage or image panels, no text, titles, readable signage, HUD, interface, radar, logo or watermark. Remove all visible characters, weapons, projectiles, hit effects and overlays. No animated claims or separated parallax layers. Storyboard references are multiple views of the same map, never a sheet layout to reproduce. Specific map: LETHAL LEVIATHAN, original Metal Gear Arcade 2010 build, the Outer Haven ship-bow combat deck. First two references are contemporary 2010 press screenshots with MAP L.L visibly printed in their HUD, last sheets are original Arcade gameplay; faithfully reproduce that version. Depict the compact steel deck corridor/open junction between massive bluish-gray naval superstructure blocks. Dominant central backdrop is the squat faceted/radius-corner light gray armor housing with a square dark ventilation grille on its face, as in the second image, with an open strip of heavy steel grating below. Flank it with tall dark blue-gray bulkhead structures, exposed vertical bolted beams and corner bracing, wall-mounted industrial lamps, low bundles of pale metal service pipes near deck level, stacked anonymous dark rectangular equipment cases near the side. Gray nonslip deck with restrained white edge lines and narrow recessed metal tracks; continuous empty foreground lane. Cool desaturated blue-gray palette, soft pale daylight from above, upper gangways and rails in shadow. Keep original Arcade module scale and cramped utilitarian geometry; no broad aircraft-carrier runway, ocean panorama, giant missile turrets, submarine exterior beauty shot or futuristic spaceship. Do not reproduce the fan-server MGO2 port or add new traversable ladder structures. No characters, statues, robots, guns, readable labels or interface.
produced.editPrompt: Edit the FIRST supplied image only, preserving its exact Lethal Leviathan original-Arcade landmark, cool steel palette, camera height and single coherent scene. Make a CQC gameplay composition correction: the bottom 20 percent of the frame must be ONE clear continuous horizontal flat deck lane edge to edge. Move both the foreground stacks of dark equipment cases back into the midground, so their bottoms sit no lower than about 68 percent of image height, on the far left and far right against walls. Move the large bolted left pillar back to the same midground plane. Keep their existing designs and do not remove the original ship architecture. Continue the empty gray nonslip deck naturally across the entire foreground with narrow inset track lines and restrained white markings. The distant light gray faceted housing with square grille, low pipes, riveted bulkheads and upper railings must remain recognizable and essentially unchanged. No people, text, interface, logos, additional weapons or machines. No expanding this into a large aircraft-carrier deck; only clear the close foreground so two fighters fit across the lane.

Render the old Middle-Eastern Red Zone district exactly in its Arcade architectural character. Ignore the filmed monitor scanlines, reflections, black borders and game overlay. Use the street/alley location of the first reference: dry light gray-beige stone and brick multi-story facades, narrow rectangular dark upper windows, thick weathered plaster over exposed brick, a low masonry shed projecting from the right side with a rough dark overhanging roof, a few stacked wooden packing boxes beside the shed, cobbled dusty ground, broken low walls and crumbled masonry at the intersection. Do not invent a giant heroic monument or place live people. Compose a faithful broad SIDE-ON view across the cobbled street in front of these facades, leaving one empty continuous level fighting lane across the entire bottom 22 percent. Midground low ruined wall and shed to the right, broken corner/pillars to left, a modest view into the narrow receding street at center; preserve the authentic compact map proportions and crumbling masonry. Desaturated olive-beige daytime color grade, strong pale daylight and deep architectural shadow, without overexposed photographed-screen glare. No cathedral, no new domes/minarets, no mosque, no banners or readable script.
